overview: PinballHEIR is a 100% on-chain, instantly playable pinball arcade on the Internet Computer where every table is its own sovereign mini-economy and mini-DAO, governed by ICFC token holders. Features 29 gameplay systems, a 9-tab table constructor, deterministic physics replay proofs, SNS-style governance, and the genesis free table "Neon Nights".
features: 9-tab drag-and-drop table constructor with sound/music tab
Full pinball game with Three.js + cannon-es physics
DAO governance with ICFC token-weighted voting and 34 proposal types
TableEconomy: per-table treasury, jackpots, referrals, leaderboard payouts
Deterministic replay proof system for dispute resolution
29 gameplay features: co-op, golden ball, ghost replay, charity tilt, easter eggs, seasons, and more
Genesis table Neon Nights (free, DAO-owned, Released)
